text:
morgan: FYI — q6b-int4 bringup revealed a nasty edge: our corpus merge step duplicated lots of paraphrases after tokenization change. short-term: need a stitch + golden sanity. Anyone available for a quick patch?

sasha: on it. do we know if it's tokenizer v2 vs quant artifact? initial diff looked like token boundaries shifted (~1-3 tokens). :thinking_face: 

lina: Labeling ops noticed the duplicates too — labelers keep getting resamples of the same prompt with tiny edits. Queue backlog spiked x2 in the last hour. i'm pausing new incoming slices to avoid wasted labels.

jai: hypothesis: tokenizer boundary shift + whitespace normalization changed our fingerprinting hash. we should re-run fingerprint with tokenizer v2 and a fuzzy match (minhash) before we do any golden promotions. suggest a 2k sample canary.

ashley: i can triage relabel backlog if you want me to. how destructive is the stitch? do we risk removing legit near-duplicates?

morgan: good q — we want conservative stitch, prefer false negatives over false positives for golden. plan: 1) run re-fingerprint with tokenized-window hash (tokenizer v2) 2) minhash at 0.85 to group candidates 3) manual review on grouped top-3 clusters 4) update golden only after relabel check.

sasha: running quick dedupe job now with this command:
```
python -m curation.dedupe \
  --tokenizer v2 \
  --fingerprint algo=token_window,size=64 \
  --minhash_thresh 0.85 \
  --input s3://redwood-curation/incoming/q6b_onboard/2026-03-22/*.ndjson \
  --output s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4589/
```
will post short summary when done (~12m).

deploy-bot: canary-model q6b-int4-v1 deployed to staging in us-west-2 :rocket: (canary id: canary-4589)

lina: thanks — i've frozen new ingestion slices and set labeler-queue to read-only for the next 30m. tagging labelers in case they need manual context: @ashley please hold on bulk assignments for now.

ashley: 👍 i'll start picking up relabels from the RQ backlog (priority: golden candidates).

jai: i'll prepare a small eval harness: run the canary 2k sample through both baseline q8b and q6b-int4-v1, compare tokenized fingerprints + confusion on labels. idea: flag items where model outputs diverge > 0.15 BLEU-ish / embedding distance.

morgan: perfect. also add a check for KV-cache prefix differences (we saw a couple of truncated completions in the initial smoke).

sasha: dedupe job finished. summary: out of 21,422 inputs, 3,112 formed clusters >=2 at 0.85; 412 clusters include at least one golden candidate. uploading cluster csv -> s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4589/cluster_summary.csv

morgan: tack on manual sample id list (first 50) to the thread so labelers can start: s3://redwood-curation/tmp/dedupe-run-4589/first50.csv

lina: doing a quick sanity audit on those 50 — any that look ambiguous i'll mark as "hold" and escalate. :eyes:

ashley: quick note from labelers: many duplicates are paraphrases that meaningfully change intent; we'll mark them as non-duplicates where needed. good call to keep conservative stitch.

jai: eval harness started. if we see >5% quality delta on golden subset we stop rollout and open regression ticket.

morgan: action items:
- sasha: run full dedupe sweep and produce cluster manifest (in progress, done for canary sample)
- lina: freeze ingestion & triage first50 (in progress)
- ashley: pick relabel backlog + review clusters that include golden candidates
- jai: run model divergence harness on canary vs baseline (in progress)
- morgan: create regression ticket if divergence >5% on golden

morgan: will reconvene in ~30m or earlier if someone sees a hard regress. thanks all — nice quick response. :thumbsup:
